context: Two teens plan a music & tech weekend
purpose: Teach: マザー/ジェイ/ナノ/音質/リスニング/ウクライナ/宮殿/下着

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今週末、ジェイポップ系のフェスとマザー牧場、両方行きたい!
lines.en: I want to hit both the J-pop fest and Mother Farm this weekend!
lines.style: Quick, cascading excitement on the opening. Bright attack. Breathless on the wants — she's already picturing it. Slight lift at the end, infectious energy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね。新しいナノサイズのイヤホン、音質テスト兼ねて持ってこう。
lines.en: That works. I'll bring the new nano earbuds — test the sound quality while we're there.
lines.style: Relaxed agreement, practical tone. Slight playful edge — he's already thinking ahead. Measured pace, like he's done this a hundred times with her. Comfortable.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リスニング能力も上がりそう。ウクライナ出身のDJも来るんだって。
lines.en: My ears might actually level up. And apparently there's a DJ from Ukraine playing.
lines.style: Forward momentum, delighted discovery in the second sentence. Slight pause before the 'and' — she's adding new information like she just learned it. Warm, inclusive tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 宮殿風のステージらしいぞ。
lines.en: Yeah, the stage setup is supposed to be palace-style.
lines.style: Knowing, almost offhand. He's already done the research and is offering it casually. Light tone, no fanfare. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 下着の替えとタオル、しっかり準備しないと。
lines.en: I need to make sure I pack extra underwear and towels properly.
lines.style: Shift to practical mode, slightly more serious. Focused, checking-the-list energy. Quick but thorough. Not rushed, just intent.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 了解、明日朝早く出発な。
lines.en: Got it — we're leaving early tomorrow morning.
lines.style: Confirmation landing with quiet warmth. Quick nod in the cadence. He's locking it in, settling the plan. Steady, reliable tone.
